name: MBR Wolfie Slots
author: Robert Palmer
upgrade_notice: Adds one-click automatic updates. No changes to the game or saved balances. If you are on 1.0.0, install this version manually once; future updates then arrive automatically.

sections.description:
Wolfie — Moonlight Slots. A moonlit four-reel slot simulator for WordPress with play tokens, original vector artwork, synthesized sound and the Big Prize Run bonus. Place it on any page with the [mbr_wolfie] shortcode.

  • Four reels, a 4×4 window and four paylines, with wagers of 1–5 play tokens
  • Big Prize Run: three or more wolves trigger 5–9 free spins where every spin wins
  • Sound synthesized live with the Web Audio API, with no audio files
  • Sealed styling: your theme and Elementor Kit can't distort the game, and the game can't touch your theme
  • Container-query layout that fits whatever column it's in, from a phone to a full-width page
  • Assets load only on pages that contain the game
  • No network requests, no cookies, no telemetry, nothing stored on your server

Just for fun. No purchases. No cash prizes.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the ZIP via Plugins → Add New Plugin → Upload Plugin and activate it.
  2. Add [mbr_wolfie] to any page or post (a Shortcode block, the Classic editor or Elementor's Shortcode widget).
  3. Optional: intro="no" hides the title block and header="no" hides the brand bar.

The full user guide (PDF) is included in the plugin folder.
sections.changelog:
1.0.1

  • New: automatic updates via Plugin Update Checker 5.7 and the Little Web Shack update feed. The MBR_WOLFIE_UPDATE_URL constant overrides or disables it.
  • New: README.md and a 16-page PDF user guide.
  • No changes to gameplay, odds or saved balances.

1.0.0

  • First release: the Wolfie Chrome extension (v1.0.3) rebuilt as a WordPress plugin, with the [mbr_wolfie] shortcode, theme isolation, container-query layout, focus-scoped Space-to-spin, conditional asset loading and Elementor support.
